descriptive_family_bootstrap.difference_definition: candidate median APE minus baseline median APE, percentage points; negative favors candidate
descriptive_family_bootstrap.limitations: Descriptive resampling of this registered set; few families, unmodeled dependence and session drift limit inference. Raw event repeats are never resampled as independent sessions. Not a prediction interval or guaranteed population coverage.
